business_summary: Bank of Zhengzhou Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, and Treasury Business segments. The Corporate Banking segment provides corporate loans and advances, trade finance and deposit taking activities, financial leasing, agency services, and remittance and settlement services to corporations, government agencies, and financial institutions. The Retail Banking segment offers personal loans and deposit taking activities, bank card business, personal wealth management services, remittance and settlement services, and collection and payment agency services to retail customers. The Treasury Business segment engages in the interbank money market transactions and repurchases transactions, as well as offers bond investment services. It also offers trade finance services, including cash management, investment banking, international trade business, and platform finance; small and micro finance, such as business, credit, and life sendings; citizen finance comprising credit card, convenient payment, and shangding card. In addition, it provides personal internet, corporate internet, personal mobile, and corporate mobile banking services. The company was formerly known as Commercial Bank of Zhengzhou Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Bank of Zhengzhou Co., Ltd. in December 2009. Bank of Zhengzhou Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Zhengzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Bank of Zhengzhou Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중화인민공화국에서 다양한 은행 상품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 기업 금융, 소매 금융 및 재무 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 기업 금융 부문은 기업 대출 및 대출, 무역 금융 및 예금 수취 활동, 금융 임대, 대행 서비스, 기업, 정부 기관 및 금융 기관에 대한 송금 및 결제 서비스를 제공합니다. 소매 금융 부문은 개인 대출 및 예금 활동, 은행 카드 사업, 개인 자산 관리 서비스, 송금 및 결제 서비스, 수집 및 지불 대행 서비스를 소매 고객에게 제공합니다. 국채사업부문은 은행간 단기금융시장 거래 및 환매거래, 채권투자 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 현금 관리, 투자 은행, 국제 무역 비즈니스, 플랫폼 금융을 포함한 무역 금융 서비스도 제공합니다. 기업, 신용, 생명 송금 등의 소규모 및 소액 금융; 신용카드, 간편결제, 샹딩카드로 구성된 시민금융입니다. 또한 개인 i를 제공합니다.
